releases.title: SEO, GEO & Marketing workflows
releases.summary: Discover search and marketing tools, build a workflow for AI search visibility, and follow versioned product updates.
added: Twelve reviewed GitHub tools for SEO audits, AI search visibility, email marketing, and social publishing.
A GEO & AI Visibility stage in the marketing growth workflow, with SiteOne Crawler, OneGlanse, and OpenSEO for AI search readiness, saved answers, brand mentions, and citations.
A public changelog with dated product updates and a separate view of work that is not yet released.
A version link in the footer so you can find the update notes for the Toools build you are using.
changed: Expand SEO & Marketing to SEO & GEO & Marketing, covering generative engine optimization and AI search visibility.
Expand Marketing & SEO Growth to Marketing, SEO & GEO Growth while preserving its existing URL.
Product updates now use consistent major, minor, and patch versions.
fixed: Keep workflow tool cards clickable when live catalog details are unavailable, using official website links and clear availability labels.
